# Orchestrata

> Planning and optimization examples and local documentation.

## Markdown guides

- [Connect an AI agent](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/for-agents/setup-reference.md): Local setup, client commands, and a read-only lead preview.
- [Airline crew assignment](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/solutions/airline-crew-assignment/index.md): Match eligible crews to overlapping flight duties. See the eligible choices, verified result, and downloadable inputs.
- [Hospital operations staffing](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/solutions/hospital-nonclinical-shift-coverage/index.md): Cover simultaneous nonclinical shifts with available staff. See the eligible choices, verified result, and downloadable inputs.
- [Healthcare supply delivery](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/solutions/healthcare-supply-delivery/index.md): Allocate available vehicles to overlapping supply deliveries. See the eligible choices, verified result, and downloadable inputs.
- [Loading dock assignment](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/solutions/loading-dock-assignment/index.md): Assign overlapping cargo appointments to distinct eligible docks. See the eligible choices, verified result, and downloadable inputs.
- [Operating room blocks](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/solutions/operating-room-block-allocation/index.md): Assign overlapping blocks to compatible rooms. See the eligible choices, verified result, and downloadable inputs.
- [Dental treatment rooms](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/solutions/dental-clinic-room-allocation/index.md): Match concurrent procedures to compatible rooms. See the eligible choices, verified result, and downloadable inputs.
- [School classroom assignment](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/solutions/high-school-timetabling/index.md): Place classes in distinct eligible rooms during one period. See the eligible choices, verified result, and downloadable inputs.
- [Field service technician assignment](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/solutions/field-service/index.md): See how prequalified technicians can be assigned to three simultaneous service jobs without double-booking. Review the worked example.
- [Workforce and shift assignment](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/solutions/workforce-scheduling/index.md): Compare shift assignments across two retail stores before and after a callout, while keeping required coverage and checking missed preferences.
- [Fleet pickup and delivery assignment](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/solutions/fleet-assignment/index.md): Explore matching three overlapping delivery jobs to eligible vans by per-job capacity and availability, without claiming live vehicle routing.
- [Call center queue staffing](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/solutions/call-center-staffing/index.md): Assign qualified agents to three concurrent support queues without double-booking. Download the exact job domains, preference, and expected assignments.
- [Airport gate assignment](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/solutions/airport-gate-assignment/index.md): Match three overlapping flights to compatible gates, avoid a conflicting gate assignment, and see how a preferred gate changes the result.
- [Cluster workload placement](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/solutions/cluster-workload-placement/index.md): Assign concurrent compute jobs to eligible nodes, keep workloads separate, and inspect the expected solution for a preferred GPU node.
- [Evaluate the planning engine](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/docs/evaluate/index.md): Use a small planning problem to evaluate hard constraints, priorities, feasibility, and search budgets in Orchestrata.
- [CLI and API reference](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/docs/api/index.md): Run a planning problem locally, understand the HTTP request and result, and handle validation and exact-search limits.
- [Planning examples and recipes](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/docs/recipes/index.md): Start with a reproducible assignment problem and see how example inputs can inform your own finite planning model.
- [Run and deploy](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/docs/deployment/index.md): Understand the difference between the static product site and the separately running planning API, including deployment limitations.
- [Solve API reference](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/docs/solve-api/index.md): Read the local solve API’s JSON request, constraint types, response fields, validation errors, and search limits.
- [Recipe API reference](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/docs/recipes-api/index.md): Inspect the recipe catalog, sample routes, and recipe grid contract in local review builds.
- [Native SDK reference](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/docs/sdk/index.md): Build the native library and call Orchestrata from C#, Go, Java, Node.js, PHP, or Python. See ABI rules, source requirements, and runnable examples.
- [Set up and troubleshoot the local backend](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/docs/backend-setup/index.md): Start the local Orchestrata backend, check the API, troubleshoot common failures, and evaluate optional persistence separately.
- [Schichten nach einem Personalausfall neu besetzen](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/de-de/solutions/workforce-scheduling/index.md): Vergleichen Sie die Schichtbesetzung in zwei Filialen vor und nach einem Ausfall. Sehen Sie, wie alle Schichten besetzt bleiben und welche Wünsche nicht erfüllbar sind.
- [Planungs-Engine testen](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/de-de/docs/evaluate/index.md): Prüfen Sie feste Regeln, Prioritäten, Lösbarkeit und Suchgrenzen anhand eines kleinen Orchestrata-Beispiels.
- [CLI- und API-Referenz](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/de-de/docs/api/index.md): Lösen Sie ein Beispiel lokal und lesen Sie Anfrage, Ergebnis und Fehlermeldungen der CLI und der HTTP-API.
- [Planungsbeispiele und Vorlagen](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/de-de/docs/recipes/index.md): Nutzen Sie ein nachprüfbares Zuordnungsbeispiel, um eigene Planungsdaten vorzubereiten.
- [Starten und bereitstellen](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/de-de/docs/deployment/index.md): Starten Sie Orchestrata lokal und prüfen Sie, was statische Website, HTTP-API und Bereitstellung jeweils abdecken.
- [Diensten opnieuw indelen na een afmelding](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/nl-nl/solutions/workforce-scheduling/index.md): Vergelijk de dienstindeling van twee winkels vóór en na een afmelding. Bekijk hoe alle diensten bezet blijven en welke voorkeuren niet haalbaar zijn.
- [De planningsengine testen](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/nl-nl/docs/evaluate/index.md): Onderzoek verplichte regels, prioriteiten, haalbaarheid en zoeklimieten met een klein Orchestrata-voorbeeld.
- [Naslag voor CLI en API](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/nl-nl/docs/api/index.md): Voer een lokaal planningsvoorbeeld uit en lees invoer, uitvoer en foutmeldingen van de CLI en HTTP-API.
- [Planningsvoorbeelden en sjablonen](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/nl-nl/docs/recipes/index.md): Begin met een reproduceerbaar toewijzingsvoorbeeld om te zien hoe je eigen planningsinvoer kunt voorbereiden.
- [Uitvoeren en implementeren](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/nl-nl/docs/deployment/index.md): Draai Orchestrata lokaal en lees het verschil tussen de statische site, de lokale HTTP-API en een implementatie.
- [Riassegnare i turni dopo un’assenza](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/it-it/solutions/workforce-scheduling/index.md): Confronta i turni di due negozi prima e dopo un’assenza. Verifica come mantenere la copertura e quali preferenze non si possono rispettare.
- [Valuta il motore di pianificazione](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/it-it/docs/evaluate/index.md): Valuta regole obbligatorie, priorità, fattibilità e limiti di ricerca con un piccolo esempio Orchestrata.
- [Riferimento per CLI e API](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/it-it/docs/api/index.md): Esegui un problema di pianificazione in locale e interpreta richieste, risultati ed errori della CLI e dell’API.
- [Esempi e modelli di pianificazione](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/it-it/docs/recipes/index.md): Parti da un esempio di assegnazione riproducibile per preparare i dati del tuo problema di pianificazione.
- [Avvio e distribuzione](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/it-it/docs/deployment/index.md): Avvia Orchestrata in locale e scopri le differenze tra il sito statico, l’API e la distribuzione del servizio.
- [Ułóż grafik ponownie po zgłoszeniu nieobecności](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/pl-pl/solutions/workforce-scheduling/index.md): Porównaj obsadę zmian w dwóch sklepach przed zgłoszeniem nieobecności i po nim. Zobacz, jak zachować pełną obsadę i z których preferencji trzeba zrezygnować.
- [Wypróbuj silnik planowania](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/pl-pl/docs/evaluate/index.md): Sprawdź reguły obowiązkowe, priorytety, wykonalność i limity wyszukiwania na małym przykładzie Orchestrata.
- [Dokumentacja CLI i API](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/pl-pl/docs/api/index.md): Uruchom przykład lokalnie i sprawdź format żądań, wyników oraz błędów narzędzia CLI i interfejsu HTTP.
- [Przykłady i szablony planowania](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/pl-pl/docs/recipes/index.md): Skorzystaj z odtwarzalnego przykładu przydziału, aby przygotować dane do własnego zadania planowania.
- [Uruchamianie i wdrażanie](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/pl-pl/docs/deployment/index.md): Uruchom Orchestrata lokalnie i sprawdź różnice między witryną statyczną, interfejsem HTTP i wdrożeniem usługi.
- [Réaffecter les postes après une absence](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/fr-fr/solutions/workforce-scheduling/index.md): Comparez les affectations dans deux magasins avant et après une absence. Voyez comment maintenir la couverture et quelles préférences ne peuvent plus être respectées.
- [Évaluer le moteur de planification](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/fr-fr/docs/evaluate/index.md): Évaluez les règles impératives, les priorités, la faisabilité et les limites de recherche sur un petit exemple Orchestrata.
- [Référence CLI et API](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/fr-fr/docs/api/index.md): Exécutez un problème en local et interprétez les requêtes, les résultats et les erreurs de la CLI et de l’API.
- [Exemples et modèles de planification](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/fr-fr/docs/recipes/index.md): Partez d’un exemple d’affectation reproductible pour préparer les données de votre propre problème de planification.
- [Exécution et déploiement](https://ilstarno.github.io/Orchestrata/fr-fr/docs/deployment/index.md): Lancez Orchestrata en local et découvrez les différences entre le site statique, l’API HTTP et le déploiement du service.
